user.title: Set up HA-Wallpanel
user.description: Configure the global screensaver. Add ?kiosk to a Home Assistant URL to hide its sidebar and title bar.

data_description.views: Includes built-in and user-created dashboards as well as their individual Lovelace views.
data_description.cards: Adding a card opens Home Assistant's visual card browser and card editor.
data_description.colors: Select Add to open the color picker. Saved colors show a preview and hexadecimal value.
data_description.schedule_enabled: The daily time range may cross midnight. Normal panel rotation resumes outside it.
